title: Total the minutes
prompt: TotalMinutes(int[] minutes) should return all the values added together, and 0 for an empty array. The starter returns only the last value. Repair the loop.
hints: Follow total through an array of two items. What does it hold after each run?
Each run must keep what total already has.
Inside the loop, add value to total and store the result back in total.
checkLabels: A single value must be the total.
Two equal values must both be counted.
A final 0 must not wipe out the total.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Starts counting at position 1 and misses the first item.
Reads one position past the end of the array.

feedback: Trace total by hand for the failing array. Check where the loop starts, where it stops, and whether each run keeps the earlier total.
